beam.desc: light beam / column, foot at b 0

crackfan.desc: crack fan from the apex forward, about +-32 degrees

crystal.desc: arena crystal cluster, foot at b 0

slab.desc: rock slab with a gold crack rim (box 1 x 0.27 x 0.4)

splash.desc: water splash crown, foot at b 0

geyser.desc: water geyser column, foot at b 0

fire_dome.desc: impact fire dome (half dome, pivot at the base)

meteor.desc: 운석 meteor: molten head at the bottom, flame trail up

ice_spike.desc: ice crystal spike, foot at b 0

prism.desc: intro seal prism (8 walls, radius 1, height 1.5)

t_hept.desc: 서리 습격 heptagram {7/2} + 大巛 rune

t_seal8.desc: 운석 seal: two squares + 火 runes

t_wall.desc: dust wall on a flank strip rail

t_gcircle.desc: intro seal gold floor glyph circle

geyser.doc: P1 Hydro geyser (the chin addon): a water column erupting with spray and a ripple. At the floor point.

blade_trail.doc: Hydro water-blade trail (at the blade prop, every 2 t): a short water streak and spray.

lump_trail.doc: Pyro lump trail (at a flying lump, every 2 t): a flame lick and smoke.

meteor_big.doc: 32 big meteor fall: the molten meteor drops from {h} (tenths) above onto the floor point in 6 t with a flame trail and a darkening floor glow.

meteor_small.doc: 32 small meteor fall from {h} (tenths) in 4 t with a short flame trail.

fire_dome.doc: 32 meteor impact: a fire dome of radius {r} (tenths) with flame tongues, a flash and a fire ring. At the floor point.

frost_burst.doc: Cryo frost burst of radius {r} (tenths; Cryo rings, 41 bursts): a ring of ice spikes, frost mist and a white flash. At the floor point.

ice_wall.doc: P7 Cryo ice-wall piece (on the swept arc): three tall ice spikes in a short row along the executor's left-right axis, frost. At the floor point, rotated along the arc.

hail.doc: Hail falling in a field of radius {r} (tenths; ambient, call every 5-10 t): three ice pellets, snow.

bolt.doc: A single Electro sky bolt onto the floor point: the bolt, a flash, a spark and a scorch ripple.

bolt_round.doc: 42 floor-wide crackle over radius {r} (tenths): two waves of six bolts 8 t apart at spread points. At the arena centre.

shell_dive.doc: 44 shell impact: a violet dome flash, arcs and a crackle ring. At the floor point.

icicle_trail.doc: Icicle / lance trail (at the icicle, every 2 t; 41, 43): frost motes and a pale streak.

ice_sphere.doc: 43 ice-sphere aura (at the sphere prop, every 4-6 t): frost glints and snow around it.

orb_ribbon.doc: 31 orb ribbon (at an orb, every 2 t): a water ribbon streak and a drop.

spark_column.doc: 44 tell: a violet spark column {h} (tenths) tall from the tail tip with crawling arcs. At the tip, foot of the column.

stele_shatter.doc: E a seal stele shatters: red-brown chunks flung out, dust and a gold crack flash. At the stele foot.

prism_shatter.doc: E the seal prism shatters (t112): gold glass blades burst outward from the prism, a white flash and a gold ring. At the prism centre (floor).

seal_reform.doc: D the seal re-forms around the dying body: gold glass blades converging inward, a gold glow and rising motes. At the body's floor point.

petrify_pulse.doc: D petrify pulse (the rig turns to stone): a grey-gold ripple and dust. At the body's floor point.

splash.doc: Water step splash (Hydro walk, water-sheet impacts): a small splash and ripple.

splash_wall.doc: P5b Hydro splash wall at the ring edge of radius {r} (tenths): ten water walls rising around the paw point.

dust.doc: P9 dust puff (rock rings, rush trails): three khaki dust clouds. At the floor point.

rock_rain.doc: P9 rock rain: six rocks falling from above within radius {r} (tenths), dust. At the floor point.

mound.doc: P9 / B3 dust mound plume at the dig / surfacing point.

light_shaft.doc: P9 gold light shaft over a rock-ring marker (8 b tall).

gold_plume.doc: P4 gold plume (the back flares and the spikes launch): a gold column up, rising glints, dust. At the back (launch point).

shard_fall.doc: P4 falling spike shard (the last 4 t before a landing): a dark gold shard dropping from {h} (tenths) with a glowing streak.

dust_wall.doc: P6 dust walls along a strip of length {len} (tenths) from the point along the executor's forward axis: five rising cream-gold walls.

boulders.doc: P7 boulders thrown up along the swept arc (five rocks fanning out from the point).

tail_lane.doc: P7 / P8 tail lane: dust and grit kicked along the tail's path (a streak and puffs along the executor's forward axis, 6 b).

leaf_burst.doc: P8 orange leaf burst (the tail's leaves scatter at the impact): ten leaves flung out and up.

cones.doc: P8 planted stone cones along the line (five cones from 2 to 12 b, staying 60 t). At the tail root, rotated as the line.

skid.doc: P3 skid gouge: a crack fan behind the stop point, dust and slabs kicked forward.

dust_trail.doc: P3 gallop dust (ambient, every 4 t of the run at the body): two dust puffs.

shock_dome.doc: Roar shock dome of radius {r} (tenths): a floor ring and a camera-facing ring expanding (v6 roar shock domes, v7 C).

emerge_spikes.doc: B3 emergence: an earth-spike cluster of radius {r} (tenths) bursting out of the floor with dust. At the surfacing point.

glyph_glow.doc: Entrance stele / arrival glyph glow (ambient, every 10 t at a glyph): a soft glow and motes.

gold_leaves.doc: E the intro roar (t120): twelve gold leaves flung radially from the head height.

gold_motes.doc: Drifting gold motes (arena ambience; ambient, every 20 t at a mote point): three slow motes.

cure.doc: The brand cleanse (butterfly-style cure fx, about 16 t): a pale-gold beam down, a white-gold burst and glints. At the player's feet.

fire_field.doc: Fire-field ambience (ambient; every 10-20 t at a live fire field of radius {r} tenths): flames, lava pops and embers over the field (33).

impact.doc: Impact burst at the floor point: Geo crystal-blade crown, Hydro splash, Pyro flame dome, Cryo ice spikes, Electro bolt and arcs; a flash and a shock ripple.

cracks.doc: Crack fan along the executor yaw over radius {r} (tenths): glowing cracks in the element colour (Geo gold, Hydro white-cyan, Pyro lava, Cryo frost, Electro violet) with debris. At the impact point, rotated as the crack line.

crown.doc: Blade crown burst (P1 / the blade crowns): 10 element blades erupting out-and-up (Geo gold crystal, Hydro water, Pyro flame, Cryo ice, Electro violet crystal). At the floor point.

dust_ring.doc: Ring of element dust around the point at radius {r} (tenths): Geo khaki dust, Hydro spray, Pyro embers and smoke, Cryo frost, Electro sparks; a ripple out to r.

slab_throw.doc: Slab / boulder throw streaks (at the slab, rotated along the throw): speed streaks behind it and a trail in the element (Geo grit, Hydro water, Pyro embers, Cryo frost, Electro sparks).

footfall.doc: Footfall at a planted foot (walk / turn plant events, plan §2.6): Geo dust, Hydro splash, Pyro flame splash, Cryo frost, Electro sparks.

brand_rune.doc: The brand rune over the player's chest (call every 4 t at the chest): the element rune card (Pyro ")火(", Hydro "ccc / |||", Electro square rune, Cryo "大巛"; Geo draws its sigil), life 5 t.

vortex.doc: Absorb vortex for {t} ticks around the body: a floor vortex spinning in, a smaller one at the chest, the element particles drawn inward (v4 A water vortex, v5 A Pyro swirl, v6 A Electro orb, v7 C Cryo).

recolour.doc: The recolour wave from the boss outward to {r} (tenths) over {t} ticks (absorb bursts, plan §2.6): an element ripple and a glow band sweeping the floor.

sigils.doc: Sigil cards around the body for the absorb (火 / 水 / ⚡ / ❄ / Geo emblem): six sigils rising and turning at 3-6 b (v5 A, v5 §4.2).

front.doc: The 3-D wave front (N10) moving with tele/wave: 12 band segments (element strip + wall: Geo dust and slabs, Hydro water wall, Pyro fire wall, Cryo frost, Electro sparks) travel from {r0} to {r1} in {dur} ticks keeping {w} deep (tenths / ticks). Call it on the tick BEFORE the strike (the fg wave_band rule). At the floor centre.

dig.doc: B3 dig in place: dust mounds and debris with the element (Geo slabs, Hydro water, Pyro embers, Cryo ice puffs, Electro violet slabs). At the body's floor point.

flank_blades.doc: P6 element blades out-and-up along a flank strip of length {len} (tenths) from the point along the executor's forward axis, leaning to its left (+x, the outer side): Geo gold blades, Hydro water jets, Pyro flames, Cryo ice spikes, Electro violet crystals.

spike_line.doc: P8 spike line along the aim, length {len} (tenths): six element spikes bursting from the floor one after another (Geo gold blades, Hydro jets, Pyro flames, Cryo ice spikes, Electro crystals).

shard_rain.doc: Absorb-2 cosmetic shard rain over radius {r} (tenths) for {t} ticks: falling element shards (Geo gold, Hydro drops, Pyro embers, Cryo icicles, Electro bolts) spread over the window. At the arena centre.

props.seal_stele: Intro seal stele (6 at r 8 around the spawn): a dark red-brown carved tablet with glowing gold cracks, 1.1 x 3.2 x 0.4 b standing on the prop (box kind, pivot at its centre: spawn it 1.6 b up).
props.seal_chunk: Seal stele chunk (shatter pieces): a 0.6 b block of the stele stone.
props.seal_prism: Intro seal prism (UUID 0x80): an eight-walled translucent gold glyph prism, radius 6 b, 9 b tall, standing on the prop.
props.gate_icon: The gate label icon (registry icon.model; also the item model rlk:mboss/az_kit/gate_icon), 1 b, turning to the viewer.

props.meteor_small: 운석 낙하 small meteor (32), 1.7 b, upright.
props.lump: Pyro molten lump (P1 / P2 / P5 extras), 1 b, camera-facing; pair with p/lump_trail.

props.ice_sphere: 쏟아지는 천화 spiky ice sphere (43), 2.2 b, camera-facing; pair with p/ice_sphere.

props.crater: B3 crater at the floor cut (UUID 0x81): the rubble crater, radius 7.5 b, flat at the prop (spawn it 0.03 b over the floor).

sounds.chin_rear: P1 rear-up (t0..t10): a deep roar and growl.
sounds.chin_impact: P1 impact t35: heavy smash, boom and crystal crack.
sounds.jump_takeoff: P2 take-off t6: a heave and a whoosh.
sounds.jump_land: P2 landing t21: smash, boom, anvil.
sounds.jump_wave2: P2 second ground wave t32: deep crack and falling stone.
sounds.charge_growl: P3 growl and coil (t0): roar + growl.
sounds.charge_gallop: P3 gallop step (every 4 t of the run): heavy steps and gravel.
sounds.charge_skid: P3 skid stop: gravel scrape and grind.
sounds.spikes_bristle: P4 bristle (t0, gold glow): charge hum.
sounds.spikes_launch: P4 launch t14: four rockets of spikes.
sounds.spikes_land: P4 spike landing: crack, dripstone thud, crystal.
sounds.spikes_explode: P4 planted spike explodes: boom and crystal.
sounds.stomp_slam: P5 / P5b paw slam: boom, golem thud, crystal.
sounds.stomp_wave: P5 / P5b ground wave: deplete thrum and a sonic charge.
sounds.feint_sway: P6 sway (call twice): heartbeat and a heavy step.
sounds.feint_burst: P6 flank eruption t22: boom, crystal, basalt.
sounds.whip_raise: P7 tail raise: a low rumble.
sounds.whip_sweep: P7 sweep t23: a wind burst and a riptide whoosh.
sounds.whip_erupt: P7 end-line eruption t33: boom and crystal.
sounds.tslam_raise: P8 tail raised high: dripping lava tick and a rumble.
sounds.tslam_impact: P8 impact t39: boom, anvil, three dripstone thuds, leaves.
sounds.burrow_dive: P9 dive: digging and roots tearing.
sounds.burrow_loop: P9 underground loop (every 30 t): muffled digging.
sounds.burrow_ring: P9 rock-ring marker: rising charge and a chime.
sounds.burrow_rock: P9 rock lands: smash and crystal.
sounds.burrow_rush: P9 surfacing rush / emergence: emerge, roar, boom.
sounds.slide_lift: T1 lift (fore + hind paw rise): heavy step and deepslate.
sounds.slide_wave: T1 waves 1-5: a wide boom (volume 2 = heard across the arena), basalt, crystal, falling stone.
sounds.slide_wave6: T1 wave 6 (the whole arena): the wave layers + the warden emerging.
sounds.msg_chime: The transition message: resonating bell and a charge.
sounds.b3_rise: B3 tail rises: emerge and dripstone.
sounds.b3_emerge: B3 emergence burst t388: boom, emerge, basalt.
sounds.orb_spawn: 31 orbs appear / pass: a riptide swirl and a splash.
sounds.orb_loop: 31 orb loop (every 20-40 t): whirlpool and conduit hum.
sounds.orb_hit: 31 orb hits a player: a splash.
sounds.meteor_impact: 32 big meteor impact: boom, dragon fireball, sizzle.
sounds.meteor_small: 32 small meteor: a blast and a light boom.
sounds.fire_loop: 33 fire field loop (every 20 t): fire and crackle.
sounds.frost_draw: 41 star drawn: resonance and a thin beacon.
sounds.frost_burst: 41 burst: powder snow breaking and a light boom.
sounds.bolt_marker: 42 round markers (48 t before): high charge and a select tone.
sounds.bolt_strike: 42 strike: thunder, bolt impacts (call again over 20 t for the 6-8 impacts), crystal.
sounds.safe_chime: 42 the player is inside a safe circle: a bright chime.
sounds.sphere_form: 43 sphere forms: select tone and chimes.
sounds.lance: 43 lance: riptide whoosh, glass and a light boom.
sounds.shell_spawn: 44 shell spawn: spell cast and resonance.
sounds.shell_impact: 44 shell impact: bolt impact and a light boom.
sounds.ice_launch: 45 launch: three breeze shots and dripstone.
sounds.hex_draw: 46 hexagram drawn: spawn-point set and enchanting.
sounds.hex_bolt: 46 bolt before a lump: thin thunder.
sounds.intro_thump: E heartbeat thump of the sealed body.
sounds.death_sting: D music cut with a sting.
sounds.death_fall: D the body falls (chin t34 / tail t66 / head t92).
sounds.brand_apply: Brand applied: a searing tone and a crystal tick.
sounds.cleanse: The brand is cleansed (butterfly-style cure chime).
sounds.shard_spawn: 응결 결정 sheds from the back.
sounds.footfall/1: Pyro footfall: a flame splash on the step.
